about_the_game:
World of Warships doesn’t only look good, it also sounds awesome! The game music composers themselves have selected 21 tracks for your enjoyment to download for free.

This package includes:


  • 21 tracks from the official World of Warships soundtrack

Key features:


  • Our soundtrack stands ready to inspire you with nautical notes that are guaranteed to make any task you accomplish while listening to it approximately 150% more daring and epic!
  • The tracks are available in both the mp3 and flac (lossless) audio formats. You are free to use them on streams and videos.

Have fun listening, Captains!
